issue.title: test_midword_peek_reveals_then_finishes_word fails under parallel check, passes in isolation
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_next_word_midword.py::test_midword_peek_reveals_then_finishes_word`
- **Repro:** `just check` (escalated scoped lane, 4 workers)

Failed once under the escalated parallel `just check` lane and passed immediately in isolation on the same tree.

## Fail

- Monitor `xfyfm84tghpp`, tool run `b82a98cbdbc8be18267511971c754094`, 2026-10-04T22:33:46Z–23:07:45Z.
- Tree: master `06a9cc7cf9` plus local restart-wait WIP (update_restart / proc observer / pending-launch; no PromptTextArea changes).
- Lane: `just test-scoped` escalated (rules: context-baseline-missing, contract-set-always, no-baseline-depth-boost, serial-budget-exceeded); 4 workers, 13042 items.
- Assertion: `assert False is True` after `pilot.press("e")` / `ctrl+t` while checking `_next_word_peek_pending()` or `_next_word_peek_visible()`.
- Triage class: NEW; no owner.

## Pass

- Isolated rerun on the same tree: `tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_next_word_midword.py::test_midword_peek_reveals_then_finishes_word` passed in 0.47s (together with two other nodes, 3 passed in 11.65s).

## Notes

Restart-wait work does not touch next-word prediction. This looks like a load-sensitive prompt-bar timing race, not a deterministic product failure.
